meta.name: vendor-risk
meta.description: ACTIVATE when integrating a new service, API, SaaS tool, SDK, npm/pip/maven package, Docker image, or any third-party dependency — or when discussing suppliers, vendors, processor agreements, or supply chain security. Also activate on imports from unknown packages or adding external webhooks/endpoints. Ensures every new vendor or dependency is assessed against the org's critical assets, data residency, and NIS2 Art. 21(2)(d) supply chain requirements.
